# `nlink-lab impair`

<!-- generated by `nlink-lab docs-gen`; do not edit by hand -->

```text
Modify link impairment at runtime.

JSON OUTPUT (with `--show --json`): `{ "lab": str, "endpoints": { "<node>:<iface>": { ... } | null } }` Schema: docs/json-schemas/impair-show.schema.json

Without `--show`, applies impairment changes; output is plain confirmation text.

Usage: nlink-lab impair [OPTIONS] <LAB> [ENDPOINT]

Arguments:
  <LAB>
          Lab name

  [ENDPOINT]
          Endpoint (e.g., "router:eth0"). Not required with --show

Options:
      --show
          Show current impairments on all interfaces

      --delay <DELAY>
          Delay (e.g., "10ms")

      --jitter <JITTER>
          Jitter (e.g., "2ms")

      --loss <LOSS>
          Packet loss (e.g., "0.1%")

      --rate <RATE>
          Rate limit (e.g., "100mbit")

      --clear
          Remove impairment

      --out-delay <OUT_DELAY>
          Egress delay (applied to named endpoint)

      --out-jitter <OUT_JITTER>
          Egress jitter

      --out-loss <OUT_LOSS>
          Egress packet loss

      --out-rate <OUT_RATE>
          Egress rate limit

      --in-delay <IN_DELAY>
          Ingress delay (applied to peer endpoint)

      --in-jitter <IN_JITTER>
          Ingress jitter

      --in-loss <IN_LOSS>
          Ingress packet loss

      --in-rate <IN_RATE>
          Ingress rate limit

      --partition
          Simulate a network partition (save impairments, apply 100% loss)

      --heal
          Restore pre-partition impairments

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```
